author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Taking care of your health just got easier – start here with my sponsor Zocdoc: https://zocdoc.com/RyanPlus

NFTs are still a thing, apparently. So should we buy them in 2026?
A few years after the NFT boom, we check in on the market to see what happened to Bored Ape Yacht Club, CryptoPunks, Beeple’s $69 million NFT, and the people who bought them.

Are NFTs actually worth anything now? Can you still make money with NFTs? And most importantly, are NFT bros doing okay?
